system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Ranged Weapons, Expertise (1) in Perception

You take the time to steady your hands and line up the shot.

As an Action, you can aim at a target you can see. Until the end of your next turn, your range is doubled, and your Accuracy when Attacking that target increases by a number equal to your Expertise in Perception.

This effect ends early if you take an Action other than attacking the target.
